notes: The second sequence writes three waws against two ASV connectives, so the waw before *they came* is `unrepresented` (rules 14, 42); the first pair *And when* is one waw's rendering under rule 55.
*Rabshakeh* fuses the title's two morphemes (rule 30), as throughout the chapter; the marginal notes on the Assyrian titles were read and set aside (rule 38).
